#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "include/gemmini_testutils.h"

// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MX matmul kernel (128x128x256, fp6:e3m2).
void solution(void) {
  {
    int ti = 4, tj = 4, tk = 16;
    uint32_t ab0 = 0;
    uint32_t ab1 = 1024;
    uint32_t bb1 = 6144;
    uint32_t bb0 = 7168;
    
    // Contiguous intermediate DRAM buffer for output quadrants (32 KB total)
    static out_t temp_C[4][1024];
    
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 1, 1, 3, 1);
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_row, sizeof(A_scales_row), 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_col, sizeof(B_scales_col), 1);
    gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)B_lut_p, 1, 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)A_lut_p, 1, 1);
    
    // Load A0 (first 64 rows of A)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      for (int k = 0; k < 16; k += 4) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i*DIM*MATMUL_K + k*DIM), ab0 + (i*16 + k)*DIM, 4 * DIM, DIM);
      }
    }
    
    // Load A1 (last 64 rows of A)
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      for (int k = 0; k < 16; k += 4) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + (i+4)*DIM*MATMUL_K + k*DIM), ab1 + (i*16 + k)*DIM, 4 * DIM, DIM);
      }
    }
    
    // Load B0 (cols 0-63 of B)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t) / 2);
    for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < 4; j += 2) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + k*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2) + j*DIM), bb0 + (k*4 + j)*DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      }
    }
    
    // Load B1 (cols 64-127 of B)
    for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < 4; j += 2) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + k*DIM*(MATMUL_N/2) + (j+4)*DIM), bb1 + (k*4 + j)*DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      }
    }
    
    gemmini_config_st(16 * sizeof(out_t));
    
    // Process 4 quadrants of output C
    for (int i_q = 0; i_q < 2; i_q++) {
      for (int j_q = 0; j_q < 2; j_q++) {
        uint32_t a_spad = (i_q == 0) ? ab0 : ab1;
        uint32_t b_spad_end = (j_q == 0) ? 8192 : 7168;
        int q = i_q * 2 + j_q;
        int SDST = 128 + q * 256;
        
        // Output scales are indexed row-major: scale_dram + m*N_blocks + bi
        uint64_t q_scale_factors = (uint64_t)scale_factors + (i_q * 64 * 8 + j_q * 4);
        gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout(q_scale_factors, 4, 4, 16, 0, 0, 9);
        
        gemmini_loop_ws_spad(4, 4, 16, 0, 0, 0, a_spad, b_spad_end, 0, SDST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&temp_C[q][0], SDST * 16, 64 * 64);
      }
    }
    
    gemmini_fence();
    
    // Host CPU copy-back to reconstruct non-contiguous C_hw structure in DRAM
    for (int i_q = 0; i_q < 2; i_q++) {
      for (int j_q = 0; j_q < 2; j_q++) {
        int q = i_q * 2 + j_q;
        for (int r = 0; r < 64; r++) {
          memcpy(&C_hw[i_q * 64 + r][j_q * 64], &temp_C[q][r * 16], 16 * sizeof(out_t));
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
